How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ICAR-CIRCOT Young Professional-II (YP-II) Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 04-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Young Professional-II post at ICAR-CIRCOT?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Young Professional-II position is 04 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the YP-II role?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a Graduate degree in Textile Technology/Textile Chemistry/Chemical Engineering/Biotechnology or a Master’s Degree in Chemistry/Environment Science/Microbiology.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Young Professional-II position?
faq.answer: The age limit for this post is between 21 years and 45 years, with relaxations applicable as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional-II post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 42,000.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Walk-in Interview or a Hybrid Mode interview.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Young Professional-II (YP-II) post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via Email.

faq.question: Q9. Where is ICAR-CIRCOT located?
faq.answer: ICAR-CIRCOT is located in Mumbai, Maharashtra, with the pincode 400019.

faq.question: Q10. Are there any desirable qualifications for the YP-II role?
faq.answer: Yes, desirable qualifications include experience in laboratory work, testing equipment, biomass analysis, and computer knowledge.
